subject: general
question: Find a single discount (rounded up to two decimal places) equal to three consecutive discounts of 3%, 27% and 23%.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount for **3%** and **27%** = 3 + 27 − (3 × 27) ÷ 100 = 30 − 0.81 = **29.19%**.

Now, combine **29.19%** and **23%** = 29.19 + 23 − (29.19 × 23) ÷ 100.

= 52.19 − (671.37 ÷ 100) = 52.19 − 6.7137 = **45.4763%**.

Rounding up to two decimal places, we get **45.48%**.

**∴ The correct answer is 45.48%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → Three successive discounts: **d₁ = 3%**, **d₂ = 27%**, **d₃ = 23%**.
Formulas: **Successive Discount = a + b − (ab ÷ 100)** | **Final SP = MP × (100−d₁)/100 × (100−d₂)/100 × (100−d₃)/100**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/899c77588cdada243bbbb2c924f3886c0a0bcaa35db0a18189fc08dbe3e46118.png] 
⇒ Let the **Marked Price (MP)** be 100.
⇒ After 1st discount: 100 × (97 ÷ 100) = 97.
⇒ After 2ⁿd discount: 97 × (73 ÷ 100) = 70.81.
⇒ After 3rd discount: 70.81 × (77 ÷ 100) = 54.5237.
⇒ Total Discount = MP − Final SP = 100 − 54.5237 = **45.4763%**.
⇒ Rounding to 2 decimal places ≈ **45.48%**.

**∴ The correct answer is 45.48%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When two or more discounts are applied one after another on the reduced price, they are called successive discounts. The order of application does not change the final result.

Single Equivalent Discount Formula

For three discounts d₁, d₂, and d₃, the equivalent discount is 1 − [(1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100) × (1 − d₃/100)] × 100%.</p
